description: This Java class initializes and resets scheduled jobs in a test suite environment, specifically adjusting the frequency of a job named 'Send Asynchronous Events' using cron expressions.

classes.name: JobSuiteInitializerStep
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for initializing and resetting scheduled jobs during test suite execution, specifically managing cron expressions for a job.

methods.name: initializeForSuite
methods.description: Sets up the job with a 1-second interval by updating the cron expression.

methods.name: resetAfterSuite
methods.description: Resets the job to a 60-second interval after the test suite finishes.

methods.name: updateExternalEventJobFrequency
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves the specific job by display name, then updates its cron schedule via API call.
